thread.title: Draft reply to Priya: contract terms

source.text:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for sending the revised contract over. We're happy to agree to net-60 payment terms. Our finance team can start invoicing from Monday once the countersigned copy is back. I'll also ask legal to narrow clause 12 to the reseller scope. The delivery date in clause 9 works for us as written. We can have the signed copy back to you by Friday.

Best,
Sam
